note: Phase 5 owns 205 function rows and 122 data objects. Forty-three function rows are closed by registered staged-pair mutations, including actor group accessors, isDynamic, createShape, and releaseShape behavior. One row, phys_fn_000002, is closed by the NxPhysicsRangeIterationTests static proof. Sixteen rows are closed by oracle differentials: eight Box shape-vtable rows, phys_fn_000829, phys_fn_000831, phys_fn_000841, phys_fn_000847, phys_fn_000849, phys_fn_001035, phys_fn_000004, and phys_fn_000012. 145 function rows remain reconstructed but not falsified, none remain unreconstructed, and no data object is dispositioned. The ledger accounts for all 205 Phase 5 function rows; the 122 data objects remain separately classified as described by their inventory records. See evidence/shape-self-001391.md and evidence/phase5-controller-release-list.md.

proof_kinds.differential_falsified: Mutations aimed at the thirty-nine staged-pair rows were caught by their registered differentials; all thirty-nine rows are closed.
proof_kinds.static_proof_falsified: The NxPhysicsRangeIterationTests mutation changed reverse stepping to forward stepping; its named checks caught the broken visitation order, callback result, and negative-stride behavior for phys_fn_000002.
proof_kinds.oracle_differential_falsified: Mutations to phys_fn_001391, phys_fn_000829, phys_fn_000831, phys_fn_000841, and phys_fn_000849, phys_fn_000955, phys_fn_000961, phys_fn_000963, phys_fn_000953, phys_fn_000967, phys_fn_000969, phys_fn_000971, and phys_fn_001035 were caught by NxPhysicsShapeVtableTests; mutations to phys_fn_000004, phys_fn_000012, and phys_fn_000847 were caught by NxPhysicsObjectLayoutTests. Each non-zero mismatch count records the failed case.

deferred_reasons.not_reconstructed_in_phase: this phase did not reconstruct this row and names nothing that blocks it. A debt, not an obstruction; no function rows remain here.
deferred_reasons.reconstructed_not_falsified: The row is reconstructed and carries a recorded proof, but no mutation has been aimed at it. This is the work the phase has left: 145 rows, each needing one mutation and one measured detection.
deferred_reasons.data_object_not_dispositioned: no closure schema lets any phase close a data object, so the data half arrives here by construction.

entry_points: the census rows this phase owns, by rva
